question: How many films are in the database? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film

question: What is the email address of the customer MARY SMITH? Return: email.
sql: SELECT email FROM customer WHERE first_name = 'MARY' AND last_name = 'SMITH'

question: What is the rental rate of the film ACADEMY DINOSAUR? Return: rental rate.
sql: SELECT rental_rate FROM film WHERE title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

question: How many actors have the last name GUINESS? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM actor WHERE last_name = 'GUINESS'

question: In which language is the film ALIEN CENTER? Return: language name.
sql: SELECT l.name FROM film f JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id WHERE f.title = 'ALIEN CENTER'

question: List the titles of all films the actor PENELOPE GUINESS appears in. Return: title.
sql: SELECT f.title FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS'

question: How many films are in the Horror category? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: Which category has the most films? If several tie, return all of them. Return: category name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT c.name, count(*) AS k FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name) SELECT name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Which actor appears in the most films? If several tie, return all of them. Return: first name, last name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name, count(*) AS k FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: In which city and country does the customer MARY SMITH live? Return: city, country.
sql: SELECT ci.city, co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address ad ON ad.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = ad.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE cu.first_name = 'MARY' AND cu.last_name = 'SMITH'

question: How many customers live in Canada? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address ad ON ad.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = ad.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: How many copies (inventory items) of the film ACADEMY DINOSAUR does store 1 have? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR' AND i.store_id = 1

question: Which staff member processed the most rentals? If several tie, return all of them. Return: first name, last name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, count(*) AS k FROM staff s JOIN rental r ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Which categories is the film AFFAIR PREJUDICE in? Return: category name.
sql: SELECT c.name FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.title = 'AFFAIR PREJUDICE'

question: What is the total amount paid by the customer ELEANOR HUNT? Return: total amount.
sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE c.first_name = 'ELEANOR' AND c.last_name = 'HUNT'

question: How many films are rated PG-13? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13'

question: What is the average length in minutes of films rated NC-17, rounded to two decimals? Return: average length.
sql: SELECT round(avg(length), 2) FROM film WHERE rating = 'NC-17'

question: How many films rated G are in the Children category? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE f.rating = 'G' AND c.name = 'Children'

question: For each film rating, how many films have that rating? Return: rating, film count.
sql: SELECT rating, count(*) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: What is the average rental rate across all films, rounded to two decimals? Return: average.
sql: SELECT round(avg(rental_rate), 2) FROM film

question: How many rentals have not been returned (they have no return date)? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL

question: Which country has the most customers? If several tie, return all of them. Return: country.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT co.country, count(*) AS k FROM customer cu JOIN address ad ON ad.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = ad.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country) SELECT country FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Which film was rented the most times? If several tie, return all of them. Return: title, rental count.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.title, count(*) AS k FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title) SELECT title, k FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: How many distinct customers have rented at least one film in the Horror category? Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT r.customer_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: What is the longest film length in minutes, and which films have it? Return: title, length.
sql: SELECT title, length FROM film WHERE length = (SELECT max(length) FROM film)

question: What is the average total paid per paying customer (sum of all payments divided by the number of distinct customers who paid), rounded to two decimals? Return: average.
sql: SELECT round(sum(amount) / count(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) FROM payment

question: What is the total of all payments ever received? Return: total amount.
sql: SELECT sum(amount) FROM payment

question: Which customer has made the most payments? If several tie, return all of them. Return: first name, last name.
sql: WITH n AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, count(*) AS k FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name FROM n WHERE k = (SELECT max(k) FROM n)

question: Use the film table's film_length column to find the length in minutes of the film ACE GOLDFINGER. Return: length.
sql: SELECT length FROM film WHERE title = 'ACE GOLDFINGER'

question: Look up the customer whose customer_name is MARY SMITH and count her rentals. Return: count.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE c.first_name = 'MARY' AND c.last_name = 'SMITH'
